name: docs
description: 오피스 문서 읽기·만들기 — pptx·xlsx·docx·hwp·hwpx·pdf 를 읽어 텍스트·표·수식을 뽑고, 렌더 블록으로 같은 형식들을 만듭니다. 만든 파일은 미디어 보관함에 저장됩니다. 회사 마스터 .pptx 를 올려 두면 그 서식 위에 만듭니다.

actions.name: 문서 읽기 (pptx·xlsx·docx·hwp·hwpx·pdf)
actions.description: Extract text and tables from an uploaded document

actions.name: PPTX 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 슬라이드)
actions.description: Build a .pptx from render blocks: header level 1 or divider starts a new slide; tables become native editable tables, chart blocks become native editable charts, callouts become tinted statement bands, and timeline/compare/key_value/progress blocks each trigger their own slide archetype

actions.name: XLSX 만들기 (표 → 시트 · 대시보드)
actions.description: Build a .xlsx. Tables become styled data sheets: bold frozen header, fitted column widths, real number formats, and automatic conditional formatting (data bars on magnitude columns, a blue-white-red color scale on %/율/증감/change/delta/yoy columns)

actions.name: DOCX 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 보고서)
actions.description: Build a .docx REPORT from render blocks

actions.name: HWPX 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 한글 문서)
actions.description: Build a .hwpx (Hancom) from render blocks via the rhwp engine, seeded from a real Hancom blank so fonts and styles are valid

actions.name: PDF 만들기 (렌더 블록 → 보고서)
actions.description: Build a .pdf REPORT from render blocks

actions.name: 서식 보관함 목록
actions.description: List the shelved master/template files (alias, kind, per-kind default) — check it when the user names a template, then pass the alias as make_*'s masterMediaPath

actions.name: 셀프테스트
actions.description: Offline round-trip checks: make each format, read it back, compare. No key, no network.

action.description: read = document -> {text, tables, meta}. make_* = render blocks -> file in the media store. selftest = offline round-trips. masters = list the shelved master/template files (alias, kind, default) — check it when the user names a template, then pass the alias as masterMediaPath.

path.description: [read] For read: the document — a media URL (/user/media/<slug>.<ext>) or workspace-relative path. Extension decides the parser (pptx/xlsx/docx/hwp/hwpx/pdf).

title.description: [make_*] For make_*: title of the deck/document — first slide/heading and the stored filename.

blocks.description: [make_*] For make_*: render-block IR [{type, props}] — the same blocks pages render. header{text,level} / text{content} / list{items,ordered} / table{headers,rows} / metric{label,value,unit,delta} / callout{title,message} / key_value{items} / progress{label,value,max} / timeline{items} / compare{left,right} / chart{chartType,labels,data|series,title} / stock_chart{data:[{date,open,high,low,close,volume}]} / image{src} / divider. CONTAINERS are flattened into their children, so nothing authored inside one is lost: grid/card/carousel/slideshow splice their children in order, tabs/accordion emit each section's title as a level-3 header before its blocks, and a page `module` block splices its rendered output (props._baked). Table rows may be lists OR records ([{column: value}]) — a record is ordered by the table's headers, and with no headers the first record's keys become the header row. header.level accepts 1, "1" or "h2". Render-fence dialect ({name:'Header',type:'component'}) is absorbed, and alert is an alias of callout. Interactive-only blocks (button/form/slider/countdown/html/lottie/plan_card/ad_slot/result_display) have no document form and are dropped — each dropped TYPE is named once in data.notes. A live_* block degrades to its static sibling labelled "(스냅샷)" when it carries inline seed rows, otherwise it is dropped with a note. In make_pptx, header level 1 or divider starts a new slide. In make_xlsx, table blocks become data sheets while metric blocks become KPI cards and chart/stock_chart blocks become native charts on a Dashboard sheet.

blocksCacheKey.description: [make_*] Cache key holding the blocks array (from a previous tool result) instead of inlining it.

headers.description: Display column titles, in order. With rowsCacheKey these are labels only — name the DATA with rowsColumns.

rows.description: Row data: [[cell, ...], ...] positional, or [{field: value}, ...] keyed by the headers. Long row sets belong in rowsCacheKey instead.

style.description: `ledger` renders the bookkeeping layout (live =SUM month/running subtotals). Omit for a plain data sheet.

period.description: [ledger] Period line printed under the title.

subtotalBy.description: [ledger] Column (header name or 0-based index) whose changes start a new subtotal group.

sheets.description: [make_xlsx] For make_xlsx: explicit [{name, headers?, rows}] — wins over the table blocks. Every sheet gets the bold frozen header, fitted widths, number formats and automatic conditional formatting. A cell string starting with "=" stays a live formula. NEVER retype a long row set: a tool result you saw only as a truncated preview carries a `_cacheKey`, so send that sheet as {name, headers, rowsCacheKey: "<that _cacheKey>"} and the server expands the cached rows into it — a 120-day candle sheet then holds 120 real rows instead of the 5 preview rows. Only part of the table? Keep the key and add rowsLimit:N (the most-recent N rows) or rowsRange:{from,to} (a date window) beside it — retyping rows to trim them is what breaks the call, not what fixes it. Inline rows win if both are given. Add style:"ledger" (+ docTitle, period, subtotalBy) to render that sheet as a 총계정원장-style document instead: gridlines off, centered docTitle over a centered period line, every cell thin-ruled, gray bold header, numbers right-aligned — and subtotalBy (a date column's header name or 0-based index) groups consecutive rows by YYYY-MM and inserts a live [월 계] band (=SUM over that month) plus a [누 계] band (=SUM from the first data row) after each month. A ledger sheet gets no data bars or color scales — it is a document, not a heatmap.

kpis.description: [make_xlsx] For make_xlsx: KPI cards on the Dashboard sheet — [{label, value, delta?, unit?, icon?, style?, max?}]. value may be a number or a live formula string ("=SUM(Data!B2:B100)"); delta colors itself (positive = red ▲, negative = blue ▼, zero = gray); each card takes a thick underline cycling blue/red/amber/green. BIG amounts: pass a HUMAN unit (value 333.6 + unit "조원", or value "333.6조원") — a raw 15-digit won amount only shrinks to stay visible, it does not become readable. Label each KPI with the fiscal year the data actually belongs to (fa ratios returns `periods` for exactly this). icon = one emoji shown before the value ("💰" → "💰 334조원") — it makes that cell text, so skip it when the number must stay SUM-able, and it is ignored on a "=FORMULA" value. style:"bar" renders the kpi instead as a progress-bar row under the cards: the big colored number, the label, and a live data bar scaled to max (default 100) — the "34% 검색유입 매출 비율" / "4.11 고객 만족도" shape. Wins over metric blocks.

charts.description: [make_xlsx] For make_xlsx: native Excel charts on the Dashboard sheet — [{type: line|bar|pie|doughnut|combo, title, sheet, labelCol, valueCols[], unit?, centerLabel?, centerValue?}]. sheet = the data sheet name; labelCol/valueCols = header names or 0-based indices in that sheet. Data is read from cells, so the chart stays editable. type "combo" = valueCols[0] as muted bars + valueCols[1] as an accent line on a SECONDARY axis (two quantities, two units, one time axis — e.g. 수량 bars with 매출 line); it needs two value columns or it falls back to bars with a note; its bars carry value labels, its line does not. type "doughnut" = a ring; Excel cannot paint text in the hole, so centerLabel (small gray) over centerValue (large navy, e.g. "83.1%") is written into merged cells directly UNDER the ring, inside the same card. Layout is automatic: every chart becomes a white card on the slate canvas, a wide chart and a ring share one band (~2/3 + ~1/3) and a lone chart spans the full width, legends always sit under the plot, and every cartesian axis shows its tick numbers (#,##0, the combo's secondary axis included). A pie/doughnut title is NOT drawn inside the chart — Excel would center it over the ring — it becomes a bold navy header cell on that card's top row. Optional unit (e.g. "단위: 백만원") renders as a small amber badge at that card's top-right. Unresolvable charts are skipped and listed in data.notes. Wins over chart blocks.

masterMediaPath.description: [make_pptx] Master/template .pptx whose theme and layouts the new deck inherits — a media URL, a workspace path, or the ALIAS of a shelved template (see the `masters` action; matching ignores case/spacing). Omitted = the shelf's default .pptx (radio-marked), else its only .pptx, else a plain deck.

maxChars.description: [read] For read: cap on returned text length (default unlimited — large text is auto-cached).

transition.description: [make_pptx] make_pptx slide transition: fade (default) | wipe | push | none.

theme.description: [make_pptx] make_pptx design tokens when no master is given — {accent, heading, body, band} as hex colors. Use the palette you designed the page with; blocks carry meaning, these carry the look. A master .pptx always wins over this.

data.description: make_*: {_mediaImport, ...counts} plus `notes` — one line per block type that could not be carried into the document (interactive-only components, a live block with no seed, an unresolvable chart) and one line per requested sheet that ended up with 0 data rows. make_xlsx also returns `sheetRows` = [{name, rows}], the data rows actually written per sheet (header excluded). Read those before answering: a 0-row sheet means the file went out incomplete, and a report that quietly lost a section is worse than one that says what it lost.

settings_fields.label: 서식 보관함
settings_fields.description: 회사 양식 등 서식 파일을 여러 개 올려 두는 곳입니다. 종류별로 대표(라디오)를 지정하면 평소엔 그 양식으로 만들고, 별칭을 불러 다른 양식으로 바꿀 수 있습니다 — "B사 템플릿으로 만들어줘". 파일은 미디어 보관함에 저장되고 여기에는 목록만 남습니다.
